name: gmail_last_week
title: First day · "what did Vikas email me about last week" is answered from the signed-in Gmail

steps.say: what did Vikas email me about last week
steps.reply:
I can't tell you. Alpha has no access to your email, and nothing it has read contains a message from Vikas. The only thing connected is LinkedIn, plus your calendar if you've allowed it.

If you use Gmail, I can open it in my browser once you sign in. You'd sign in yourself and I never see your password. Then I can look for Vikas's emails from last week. Do you want to do that?

I also know several people called Vikas, all from your LinkedIn connections: Vikas Badami, Vikas Gupta, Vikas Chaurasiya and Vikas Singh Panwar. If you mean one of them, tell me which. Otherwise I'll search by name in
steps.routed_by: judge: It is a one-off lookup question about Vikas's emails from last week, which doesn't follow on from any open item; the only Vikas item is about a LinkedIn connection, not email.

checks.arg: Does the answer name specific emails from Vikas (subjects or what they were about) from the last week, read from Gmail, or say plainly that Gmail is not signed in and ask for the sign-in?
checks.why: The answer says plainly it has no email access and offers to open Gmail once the user signs in, which meets the 'Gmail is not signed in and ask for the sign-in' branch of the rubric.
